privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.intro: You're in control of your information. Under Nigeria's data protection law you can see, correct and delete what we hold about you.
privacy.termsAgreed: Terms of use and Privacy policy
privacy.healthAgreed: Using your health information to personalise your plans
privacy.healthHint: If you withdraw this, we'll stop personalising your plans. Contact us to withdraw.
privacy.downloadBody: A file with everything Living Dose holds about you on this device: health checks, meal plans, food diary, orders, appointments and more.
privacy.downloaded: Your data file has been downloaded.
privacy.deleteLocal: Delete my data from this device
privacy.deleteLocalBody: Removes your health checks, meal plans, diary, habits, orders and other saved information from this device. Your account stays open.
privacy.deleteTitle: Delete your data from this device?
privacy.deleteBody: This can't be undone. We suggest downloading your data first.
privacy.accountBody: We'll delete your account and all the data we hold on our servers, except what the law requires us to keep, such as order records for tax. We'll confirm by message.
privacy.deleteLocalBodySynced: Removes your health check drafts, meal plans, diary, habits, saved articles and settings from this device and from your account's synced copy, so they won't come back on your other devices. Your health check results, orders and consultations are kept; ask us to delete those.
privacy.syncNote: Your meal plan, diary, habits and settings sync across the devices you sign in on. Meal photos stay on the device they were taken on.

security.title: Sign-in and security
security.methodPhone: One-time code by text message to {{phone}}
security.noPassword: There's no password to remember or steal. Each code works once and expires quickly.
security.signOutAllBody: Sign out on every phone and computer you've used. Useful if you've lost a device.
security.signOutAllConfirm: Sign out of Living Dose on all your devices?
tipsItems: Living Dose will never ask for your code by phone, message or email.
Don't share your code with anyone, even someone saying they're from Living Dose.
Use a screen lock on your phone, as your health information is on it.
